title: Flight plan timeline, elapsed time 1:30–3:00: EVA prep, depressurization, open hatch
description: Vertical elapsed-time axis from 1:30 to 3:00 with scheduled crew activities listed alongside, including "EGRESS PREPARATION", "GO/NO GO FOR EVA", "DEPRESSURIZATION", "CLOSE WITH BOOSTER" and "OPEN HATCH AND STAND UP". Boxed tracking-station codes (TEX, GYM, CNV, BDA, CYI, KNO, TAN, CRO, CTN, HAW) run down the right margin beside a hatched bar labeled "NIGHT". Handwritten annotations in the left margin read in part "c.e.t. 3:59" with a checkmark and circled "GO".
